# Decision history — evidence-intake-project

Every revision of every decision, plus the terminal revisions of other normative records. Includes archived records: this is the project's memory of what it used to think.

## evidence-intake-project.decision.painted-window-chrome

### Revision 1 — The Windows frontend keeps native buttons and paints its own depth and grouping

`proposed` · `@evidence-intake-project.decision.painted-window-chrome/1` · scope `path "src/gui/winsafe.rs"`

The WinSafe frontend keeps stock Win32 push buttons and adds depth and grouping by painting the parent window in WM_PAINT, rather than by owner-drawing the buttons. Each button gets a two-band drop shadow offset down and right -- #EC then #DE against the #F0F0F0 BTNFACE background, the darker band painted last so it lands against the button's own edge -- and etched rules separate the rail's three command groups and the review panel from the output above it. Owner-draw was rejected because it would have to reimplement hover, focus, pressed, disabled, and high-contrast rendering, and would then drift from whatever the user's Windows theme does; painting only the space around a button buys the depth without owning any of the button's state.

## evidence-intake-project.decision.structure-not-verdict

### Revision 1 — Decision views report structure; they never score, rank, or predict a case

`proposed` · `@evidence-intake-project.decision.structure-not-verdict/1` · scope `path "docs/domain-rules.md"`, `path "docs/search.md"`, `path "docs/standing.md"`, `path "src/store.rs"`, `path "src/views.rs"` · topic `presentation`

Read models may report facts about how a case's material is connected -- distinct originals behind an element, a sole source carrying it, unchecked support, whether a gap touches a charge -- and may order results by such facts. They may not score a charge, rank elements by strength, label anything weak, or estimate an outcome. Full-text relevance ranking is permitted because it ranks text matches rather than evidence, and the relevance value is not reported. The product goal is a defender understanding what they have in minutes, which needs more than an inventory; the risk is that a strength number is a rearrangement of counts they could already see, carrying an authority it has not earned, and a defender reading one stops looking. Reporting structure gives the same speed while every claim stays checkable and arguable.
